elements.name: Switch between open parts

steps.name: the MCAD Software has two open part documents
the first part contains an empty sketch
the second part contains a rectangular sketch profile
the first part is active
the user selects the second part's document tab
the second part becomes active
its rectangular profile appears in the viewport
the model browser shows the second part
the application title identifies the second part
the user selects the first part's document tab
the first part becomes active
its model browser and viewport are displayed
the second part remains available as an open tab

elements.name: Inspect a document tab's context menu

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
the user opens the document tab's context menu
the menu offers Close, Close Tabs, Close All, Save and Properties
it displays shortcuts for Close and Save
the user dismisses the menu
the document remains active

elements.name: Hide and restore the document tab strip

steps.name: multiple documents are open in the MCAD Software
document tabs are visible
the user clears Document Tabs in the View tab's User Interface menu

elements.name: Open the extended window list when tabs are hidden

steps.name: multiple documents are open in the MCAD Software
document tabs are hidden
the user opens the Switch menu on the View tab

elements.name: Switch to the neighboring part with the keyboard

steps.name: two neighboring part tabs are visible in the MCAD Software
the left-hand part is active
the user presses Control+Tab
the right-hand part becomes active
its model browser and viewport are displayed
the left-hand part remains open

elements.name: Inspect properties of an inactive document from its tab

steps.name: the MCAD Software has two open part documents
the first part is active
the second part has been saved
the user opens the second part's document tab context menu
the first part remains active in the workspace
the user chooses Properties from the context menu
the properties dialog identifies the second part
its General page displays the file name, location, size and timestamps
the user closes the properties dialog without making changes
the first part remains active in the workspace
the second part remains open

elements.name: Close a saved inactive document with its tab close button

steps.name: the MCAD Software has two open part documents
the first part is active
the second part is saved and has no unsaved changes
the user clicks the close button on the second part's document tab
the second part's tab disappears
the first part remains active in the workspace
no save prompt is displayed

elements.name: Close a newly created empty active part

steps.name: a part document is active in the MCAD Software
other documents are also open
the user creates a new empty part from a standard metric template
the new part becomes active and has its own document tab
the user clicks the close button on the new part's tab without editing it
the new part's tab disappears without a save prompt
the previously active part is displayed again
its model browser and viewport are restored

elements.name: Cancel closing a part while editing its sketch

steps.name: a new part is open in the MCAD Software
the user is editing a sketch in the part
the environment-exit message is enabled
the user clicks the close button on the part's document tab
a dialog asks whether to exit the sketch environment and continue
the dialog offers OK and cancels
the user chooses Cancel
the part remains open
the sketch editing environment remains active

elements.name: Cancel the save prompt after leaving sketch editing to close

steps.name: a new part contains an unsaved sketch in the MCAD Software
the user is editing that sketch
the environment-exit message is enabled
the user clicks the close button on the part's document tab
the user chooses OK to exit the sketch environment and continue
a save-changes prompt identifies the part
the prompt offers Yes, No and cancels
the user chooses Cancel at the save-changes prompt
the part remains open
its sketch remains listed in the model browser
the part modeling environment is active

elements.name: Cancel the first save while closing an unsaved part

steps.name: a new part with an unsaved sketch is active in the MCAD Software
the part is in the modeling environment
save-change prompts are configured to always show
the user clicks the close button on the part's document tab
a save-changes prompt identifies the part
the user chooses Yes to save changes
a Save As dialog opens with a suggested file name
the user cancels the Save As dialog
the part remains open and active
its sketch remains listed in the model browser

elements.name: Save a new part while closing its tab

steps.name: a new part with an unsaved sketch is active in the MCAD Software
another part was active before the new part was created
save-change prompts are configured to always show
the suggested file name does not exist in the selected folder
the user clicks the close button on the new part's document tab
the user chooses Yes in the save-changes prompt
the user accepts the suggested file name in the Save As dialog
the part file exists at the selected location
the new part's tab disappears
the previously active part is displayed
the user reopens the saved part file
the reopened part is active
its sketch is listed in the model browser

elements.name: Close an inactive saved document from its tab menu

steps.name: multiple part documents are open in the MCAD Software
the first part is active
the second part is saved and has no unsaved changes
the user opens the second part's document tab context menu
the user chooses Close
the second part's tab disappears
the first part remains active in the workspace
no save prompt is displayed

elements.name: Switch between a drawing and a part being edited

steps.name: a drawing and a part are open in the MCAD Software
the part has an active sketch editing environment
the drawing is active with its drawing resources branch collapsed
the user selects the part document tab

elements.name: Activate a document from the tab-strip window list

steps.name: a drawing and a part are open in the MCAD Software
the part is active
document tabs are visible
the user opens the document list at the end of the tab strip
the list contains the open part and drawing
the active part is marked in the list
the menu offers Arrange, Horizontal Tile, Vertical Tile and Restore All
the menu offers separate Close Tabs and Close All items
the user selects the drawing from the list
the drawing becomes active
its sheet and drawing browser are displayed
the part remains open

elements.name: Reorder an active drawing tab

steps.name: a drawing and several other documents are open in the MCAD Software
the drawing is active and its tab is visible
the user drags the drawing tab left across several neighboring tabs

elements.name: Reorder an inactive part tab

steps.name: a drawing and several parts are open in the MCAD Software
the drawing is active
an inactive part tab is visible
the user drags the inactive part tab left across several neighboring tabs

elements.name: Detach an active drawing from the tab strip

steps.name: a drawing and a part are open in the MCAD Software
the drawing is active in the main document tab strip
the user drags the drawing tab from the strip into the workspace

elements.name: Inspect the detached drawing tab context menu

steps.name: a drawing is open in a separate window in the MCAD Software
the drawing has a document tab in that window
the user opens the detached drawing tab context menu

elements.name: Switch shared controls between a detached drawing and a part

steps.name: a drawing is open in a separate window in the MCAD Software
a part is open in the main workspace
the part context is active in the main workspace
the user clicks the detached drawing sheet

elements.name: Switch backward and forward between neighboring part tabs

steps.name: two part tabs are adjacent in the MCAD Software
the part on the right is active
the user presses Control+Shift+Tab
the part on the left becomes active
its viewport and model browser are displayed
the user presses Control+Tab
the part on the right becomes active again
its viewport and model browser are displayed

elements.name: Cancel the extended window selection

steps.name: several documents are open in the MCAD Software
a part is displayed in the workspace
the Select Window dialog is open with another part highlighted
the user chooses Cancel
the Select Window dialog closes
the original part remains displayed in the workspace

elements.name: Activate an open sketch from the Switch menu

steps.name: two parts are open in the MCAD Software
the first part is displayed in the workspace
the second part has an active sketch editing environment
the user opens the Switch menu on the View tab

elements.name: Visit Home without leaving an active sketch

steps.name: a part is open in the MCAD Software
the part has an active sketch editing environment
the user chooses Home from the View tab's Switch menu

elements.name: Preview an inactive document from its tab

steps.name: two part documents are open in the MCAD Software
the first part is active and the second has an empty sketch visible
the user hovers over the second part's document tab

elements.name: Preview Home while a part is active

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the Home workspace is available in the document tab strip
the user hovers over the Home tab

elements.name: Reveal earlier tabs without changing the active document

steps.name: many documents are open in the MCAD Software
the tab strip overflows its available width
a presentation is active while earlier tabs are out of view
the user clicks the left navigation arrow at the end of the tab strip

elements.name: Reveal an off-screen tab when selecting its document

steps.name: many documents are open in the MCAD Software
the tab strip overflows its available width
an open part's tab is outside the visible portion of the strip
the user selects that part from the View tab's Switch menu

elements.name: Show the location of a saved document in its tab preview

steps.name: two parts are open in the MCAD Software
the first part is active
the second part has been saved to a file
the user hovers over the second part's document tab

elements.name: Preview the active saved document from its tab

steps.name: a saved part is active in the MCAD Software
the part is being edited in a sketch
the user hovers over the active part's document tab

elements.name: Inspect the Home tab context menu

steps.name: the Home workspace is active in the MCAD Software
documents are open in the tab strip
the user right-clicks the Home tab
the context menu offers separate Close Tabs and Close All items
the user presses Escape
the context menu closes
the Home workspace remains active
the open documents remain available in the tab strip

elements.name: Inspect the inactive Home tab without switching documents

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the part is being edited in a sketch
the Home tab is visible but inactive
the user right-clicks the Home tab
its context menu offers separate Close Tabs and Close All items
the part's sketch remains displayed and active

elements.name: Open a second window for a part and returns to the first

steps.name: a saved part is active in the MCAD Software
a sketch is being edited in the part

steps.name: Home and a part window are adjacent in the MCAD Software tab strip

the user presses Control+Shift+Tab
the Home workspace and its recent documents are displayed
the part window remains open
the user presses Control+Tab

elements.name: Wrap keyboard navigation between Home and the last window

steps.name: Home and several document windows are open in the MCAD Software

Home is active
the user presses Control+Shift+Tab
the part's second window becomes active

the first window displays the sketch in an orthogonal view
the second window displays the part in an isometric view
